title: StudioCommentList
description: GET /lessons/:lessonId/items/:item/comments (2.17.0): the comments with their current text, the hash of the text being previewed, and what the caller may do.

previewHash.description: Hash of the text the reviewer is looking at; sent back with Approve. Null when the text cannot be read now.

counts.description: Open change requests by state; open + sent + changed is the number the top bar shows and Approve waits on.

approved.description: The item (and facet) is approved now.

approvedHash.description: The preview hash that was approved, when approved.

send.description: There is an open comment and the caller may send it.

accept.description: There is a changed comment to accept.

approve.description: No change request is open, the caller may approve and the item is ready to be approved.
